stories.title: Venezuela–US confrontation: sanctions, strikes and the Maduro standoff

seed.text: The escalating US–Venezuela confrontation: sanctions and oil brinkmanship, a US naval build-up in the Caribbean, strikes on alleged narco-trafficking vessels, and Washington's push to force Nicolás Maduro from power.

stories.title: Russia–Ukraine war: strikes, deep drones and the Trump peace track

seed.text: The grinding Russia–Ukraine war through 2025–2026: Russian missile and drone barrages on Kyiv, Ukrainian deep strikes on Russian refineries and depots, NATO airspace incursions, and Trump's on-again, off-again push for a ceasefire.

stories.title: US midterm elections 2026: the road to November

seed.text: The political arc into the November 2026 US midterms: Trump's approval swings, a record-long government shutdown, redistricting and filibuster fights, primary upsets, and prediction-market odds on control of the House and Senate.
